title: Clearcuts NISAR caught
summary: Spike vs OPERA DIST-ALERT-HLS: at similar recall, 35.7% of NISAR flags were clearcuts vs 4.6% for Sentinel-1.

title: Kaiser Canyon Fire
summary: Sentinel-1 wins here: 40.6% of burned 1-ha blocks dropped at least 2 dB in C-band VH vs 4.7% in NISAR HV. Mostly a grass and shrub fire.

title: Edouard floods under forest
summary: NISAR HH brightened 3 to 6 dB along the flooded creek bottomland; Sentinel-1 had no pass during the flood.
